findings.title: Fall-back DST: still-future local run is skipped because ordering uses UTC instants, not wall time
findings.evidence: candidate is built with the pre-transition offset (fold=0) and compared to local by UTC instant, before the +timedelta(days=1) recombine.
findings.recommendation: Decide the day by wall clock, not by UTC instant: compare 'local.replace(tzinfo=None) < wall' (or resolve both folds with candidate.replace(fold=1) and pick the earliest instant strictly greater than after). Concretely, with America/New_York, after=2024-11-03T06:10Z which is local 01:10 EST, run_at=01:55 returns tomorrow instead of 2024-11-03T06:55Z, skipping the run. Add a regression test for the repeated hour.

findings.title: Spring-forward gap wall time is silently shifted instead of rejected or shifted forward
findings.evidence: datetime.combine with tzinfo=tz accepts a nonexistent local time and resolves it with fold=0 semantics, giving an instant one hour later than the requested wall time.
findings.recommendation: Detect nonexistent local times (for example compare 'candidate.astimezone(tz).replace(tzinfo=None) != wall' for fold in (0, 1)) and skip to the next day or document and test the chosen forward-shift behaviour.

findings.title: Aware run_at is silently stripped instead of rejected
findings.evidence: run_at's tzinfo is dropped with replace(tzinfo=None) rather than validated, so an aware UTC time passed by mistake is reinterpreted as wall time in tz_name instead of being converted.
findings.evidence_quote: wall = run_at.replace(tzinfo=None)  # run_at is a wall time in tz
findings.recommendation: Raise ValueError when run_at.tzinfo is not None (mirroring the check on after), or convert it with astimezone(tz) when it is aware; also reject run_at values carrying fold information that is not explicitly honoured.

findings.title: No tests for the DST and boundary behaviour this function depends on
findings.evidence: The new module has no accompanying tests despite depending on tzdata and on transition edge cases.
findings.evidence_quote: def next_daily_run(after: datetime, run_at: time, tz_name: str) -> datetime:
findings.recommendation: Add unit tests covering: after exactly equal to the candidate, spring-forward gap wall time, both occurrences of the repeated hour on fall-back day, a half-hour-offset zone (e.g. Australia/Lord_Howe), an invalid tz_name, and a naive after.
